name: @engramprotocol/mcp-server
description: MCP wrapper for the EML HTTP API — exposes the Engram Protocol as MCP tools for Claude Code and other MCP clients, plus the Claude Code hooks (boot + reminder) as CLI commands.

scripts.prepublishOnly: test -f dist/cli.js || (echo '❌ dist/cli.js missing — run: pnpm -F @engramprotocol/core build && pnpm -F @engramprotocol/mcp-server build' && exit 1)
